definition_lines: Auxesis: the deliberate arrangement of words or ideas in increasingly forceful order.
templates: Auxetically escalating from '[least intense]' to '[more intense]' and finally '[most intense]', (author) progressively intensifies ..., positioning ...
examples: Auxetically escalating from ‘uncomfortable’ to ‘unsafe’ and finally ‘dangerous’, Wargan progressively intensifies the consequences of unchecked retail crime, positioning local shoppers to fear that continued passivity will progressively threaten their community.
